title: STEAM SOUL — 984 Games Eaten Into KenshiReborn Engine DNA
thesis: Every game Kevin played teaches KenshiReborn something. 14,941 hours of gameplay = 14,941 hours of engine research. Each genre cluster maps to an engine subsystem. The games ARE the spec.

teachers.lesson: Open world LOD at massive scale. Korean MMO-grade character rendering. Hair/cloth sim. 193GB installed = DENSE assets.
Unreal Engine 5 renderer: Nanite, Lumen, virtual shadow maps. THIS is the target to BEAT. 193GB of dense world.
UE5 at its best — particle effects, boss animations, Chinese architecture rendering. 140GB.
Decima engine. Terrain streaming, weather systems, volumetric clouds. Kojima-level fidelity.
REDengine 4. Dense urban rendering, ray-traced reflections, crowd systems. Night City = dense.
Decima engine. Procedural vegetation, machine rendering, LOD at distance.
Wind + grass particles, dynamic weather, painterly post-processing. BEAUTY.
Source 2 VR. Physics interaction in VR, hand tracking, VR comfort.

RENDERER — barraCuda + coralReef.kenshi_reborn_application: barraCuda WGSL shaders must handle Kenshi's vast desert + cities at Stalker 2 fidelity on RTX 5090. Vulkan f64 physics, Nanite-style mesh streaming, volumetric weather.

teachers.lesson: EVERY PIXEL IS SIMULATED. Falling sand physics at massive scale. THIS is the physics dream.
Factory physics — conveyor belts, fluid dynamics, power grids. Interconnected systems.
The GOLD STANDARD of optimization. Millions of entities, no lag. ECS architecture.
Colony sim physics — gas dynamics, liquid flow, heat transfer, germs. DEEP simulation.
Voxel destruction, vehicle physics, gravity simulation. Full-body physics.
Tile-based world physics, liquid flow, projectile physics. 2D but DEEP.

PHYSICS — barraCuda GPU compute.kenshi_reborn_application: Kenshi needs squad combat physics, building stability, weather effects, wound system. GPU-accelerated physics on RTX 5090. Noita-style falling sand for terrain deformation.

teachers.lesson: D&D 5e AI — initiative, reactions, party AI, companion personality. DEEP dialogue trees.
Larian's AI — elemental combos, environmental awareness, tactical positioning.
CRPG party AI, kingdom management AI, alignment-based decisions.
40K faction AI — each faction has distinct behavior. Classification system.
FCS AI system — 200+ task types, 70+ event triggers. Squad AI. THIS IS THE TARGET.
Skill-based internal dialogue. AI as internal monologue. PERSONALITY SIMULATION.
NPC schedule AI — time-based routines, relationship tracking, gift preferences.

AI — squirrel MCP + Ollama tissue models.kenshi_reborn_application: Kenshi's FCS AI gets REPLACED by squirrel MCP agents backed by 68 Ollama models. NPCs make real decisions. Emergent behavior. LLM-driven dialogue. Each NPC has a personality model.

teachers.lesson: 701 zones, seamless streaming. The BASELINE to beat.
FromSoft's seamless open world. Dense dungeons + vast overworld. Zero loading.
Bethesda's cell-based streaming. Modding-friendly world format.
Campaign map → battle map transition. Two-scale world.
Unreal Engine streaming of Bethesda's cell-based world. The COMPARISON.

WORLD STREAMING — loamSpine + nestGate.kenshi_reborn_application: loamSpine DAG-driven zone streaming. Content-addressed chunks via nestGate CAS. Verifiable world state. Branch/merge world saves via rhizoCrypt.

teachers.lesson: Card synergy, energy system, relic combos. PURE deckbuilding.
Poker + roguelike. Probability, multipliers, joker combos. MATHEMATICAL beauty.
Chain mechanics, graveyard interaction, meta-game evolution.
Faction cards, unit stats, army composition. THIS IS THE CLASSIFIER.

CARD/DECKBUILDER — immune classifier TCG.kenshi_reborn_application: The Anderson immune classifier gets a TCG overlay. Each classified entity becomes a card with stats. The Warhammer factions MAP to Anderson spectrum categories. Slay the Spire's energy system = compute budget allocation.

teachers.lesson: THE GAME. Base building, squad management, crafting, trading. No hand-holding.
Deep survival sim — nutrition, illness, vehicle repair, barricading.
Vehicle as home. Repair/upgrade loop. Zone-based exploration with car.
PvP survival. Loot economy, player interaction, base raiding.
Base building PvP. Raid mechanics. Decay system. Social dynamics.
Build from NOTHING on water. Resource management. Cooperative survival.

SURVIVAL/CRAFT — the Kenshi CORE.kenshi_reborn_application: Kenshi IS survival/craft. Every hour of these games is direct engine spec. Base building → ECS entities. Squad management → agent orchestration. Crafting → DAG pipelines.

teachers.lesson: Systems that optimize themselves. Prestige mechanics. Exponential growth.
Factory idle. Production chains. Automation.
Incremental with strategy layer. Perks, challenges, portals.

IDLE/OPTIMIZATION — Gaia's heartbeat.kenshi_reborn_application: The ORGANISM pattern. biomeOS IS an idle game — 23 mushrooms and 35 crons run themselves. Kenshi's base management can learn from idle game prestige mechanics for colony evolution.

teachers.lesson: Stance-based combat, ki pulse, yokai abilities. DEEP action combat.
Open world + soulslike. Build variety, invasions, co-op.
Posture system, deflection, stealth. PRECISION combat.
Yokai shift, burst counters. More layers than Nioh 1.
72 transformations, spell system, boss design.
Mechanical arm customization, Pinocchio's lie system.
The foundation. Rolling, stamina, weapon arts.

SOULSLIKE — combat system.kenshi_reborn_application: Kenshi's combat is squad-based and automated. KenshiReborn KEEPS that but adds soulslike precision for player-controlled characters. Stance system from Nioh. Posture from Sekiro. The player can zoom into any squad member and fight soulslike.

teachers.lesson: 3D virtual tabletop. Map building, token movement, fog of war. D&D DIGITIZED.
Tabletop rules in digital form. Army lists, turn order, morale.

TABLETOP DIGITAL — the overlay layer.kenshi_reborn_application: The GOD EYE view. KenshiReborn's world seen from above IS a tabletop game. TaleSpire's fog of war = Kenshi's fog of war. The Steam Frame displays the tabletop view. Players can interact with the world like a tabletop game.

total_engine_research.note: 12,234 hours of gameplay = 12,234 hours of engine R&D. Kevin didn't just play games. He STUDIED them.

primal_to_game_mapping.barraCuda: renderer + physics (Crimson Desert, Stalker 2, Noita, Satisfactory)
primal_to_game_mapping.squirrel: AI agents (BG3, DOS2, Pathfinder, Warhammer 40K, Disco Elysium)
primal_to_game_mapping.nestGate: world storage (Kenshi zones, Elden Ring seamless, Skyrim cells)
primal_to_game_mapping.loamSpine: world streaming (DAG-driven, Elden Ring-style zero loading)
primal_to_game_mapping.sweetGrass: provenance (mod signing, save verification, content attribution)
primal_to_game_mapping.rhizoCrypt: save system (branch/merge saves, DAG history, verifiable state)
primal_to_game_mapping.bearDog: identity + modding (Ed25519 signed mods, player identity)
primal_to_game_mapping.petalTongue: UI/HUD (MyGUI replacement, egui + WASM, TaleSpire overlay)
primal_to_game_mapping.skunkBat: anti-cheat (network defense, tamper detection, VAC replacement)
primal_to_game_mapping.songBird: multiplayer mesh (LAN/WAN transport, peer discovery, voice)
primal_to_game_mapping.sourDough: audio (Wwise replacement, positional audio, procedural soundscapes)
primal_to_game_mapping.swarmVine: gossip protocol (world state sync, player state propagation)
primal_to_game_mapping.toadStool: service discovery (game server browser, mod repository)
primal_to_game_mapping.dromedary: reverse proxy (game server routing, CDN for assets)
